title: Passenger |Third-Party Submission | Travel Agent | NOA Required | Manual Handling |
description:
A travel agent (not the passenger) submits a claim on behalf of their client. System detects third-party submission at the very first check and requires Notice of Authorization (NOA). Tests the Third Party Handoff flow from Miro. 

Prerequisites:
Claimant is a travel agent (NOT the passenger); Passenger: "Emma Watson" on PNR TCED16; Agent: "Mark Johnson" from "TravelCo Agency"
